items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 12 September 2026 5:47am
items.description:
##Today##

A wet and windy start with a spell of rain or drizzle, turning heavy at times before clearing later in the morning. Mostly dry in the afternoon with sunny intervals and only isolated showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-10, risk of 15 on higher ground.


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 25-30 with gusts of 35-40 in places at first, soon decreasing 20-25 with gusts of 30-35, veering W or SW 15-20 through the afternoon, then NW in the evening. Becoming Variable 5-10 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds for a time.
